name: vibedev_rail_project_context_build
content: - Build runs must invoke run_coding_task before any shell/file pre-inspection. Pass the original VibeDev user prompt, repo_path, project context and constraints into run_coding_task; the coding engine owns repo inspection inside its shadow workspace.

metadata.description: Build-only half of the `@vibedev` chat rail's project-context guidance, rendered above the mode-neutral vibedev_rail_project_context prose for a build run and never for a Discuss run. Its Discuss counterpart is vibedev_rail_project_context_plan.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Split out of vibedev_rail_project_context v1.0.0 so the run's mode selects its guidance instead of a post-render text swap.
